name: summarization_narrations
query: SELECT date, flag, payee, narration, account, position FROM OPEN ON 2016-01-01 CLOSE ON 2017-01-01 CLEAR WHERE flag IN ('S', 'T') AND narration ~ 'Coffee|Checking' ORDER BY flag, account
notes: Narrations of the synthetic transactions: "Opening balance for '<account>' (Summarization)" and "Transfer balance for '<account>' (Transfer balance)". The counterpart posting (Equity:Opening-Balances, Equity:Earnings:Current) has the narration of the account it balances. Payee is NULL.
